tiles.name: Classic Ivory
tiles.blurb: Warm ivory on a jade-green lacquer back. The set every club starts with.

tiles.name: Imperial Jade
tiles.blurb: Solid mottled jade, glyphs carved by brush and a cloud engraved on every back.

tiles.name: Obsidian & Gold
tiles.blurb: Black volcanic glass with gold-leaf glyphs and kintsugi veins across the backs.

tiles.name: Mother of Pearl
tiles.blurb: Iridescent shell faces that shift colour as they turn, on lilac scallop backs.

tiles.name: Ice Crystal
tiles.blurb: Clear faceted glass. Gem-coloured glyphs glow from inside. A bright glass click.

tiles.name: Carrara & Nero
tiles.blurb: White Carrara faces carved like a monument, backed in veined black stone.

tiles.name: Imperial Gold
tiles.blurb: Solid gilded tiles, filigree corners and an embossed dragon seal on every back.

tiles.name: Rose Champagne
tiles.blurb: Blush faces, rose-gold backs with an Art Deco fan, and fine Song calligraphy.

tiles.name: Blue & White Porcelain
tiles.blurb: Ming porcelain: cobalt brushwork on white glaze, with waves painted on the backs.

tiles.name: Malachite & Gold
tiles.blurb: Banded malachite bodies with white faces framed in gold.

tiles.name: Cinnabar Lacquer
tiles.blurb: Carved red lacquer faces with gold brushwork, on black lacquer bodies.

tiles.name: Walnut & Brass
tiles.blurb: Oiled walnut faces inlaid with bone and brass. A hollow wooden click.

tiles.name: Noyer & Ivoire
tiles.blurb: The grand-maison set: ivory resin faces fused to solid walnut backs, each stamped with a gilt sparrow seal.

tiles.name: Amethyst Regalia
tiles.blurb: Polished amethyst in a gold bezel, gilt symbols and ruby cabochons set into every face.

tiles.name: Gilded Porcelain
tiles.blurb: White porcelain with a beaded gilt frame, on blush backs with a layered resin edge.

tiles.name: Bone & Bamboo
tiles.blurb: The antique way: hand-carved bone faces dovetailed into bamboo backs.

tiles.name: Harbour Lights Tiles
tiles.blurb: The Hong Kong season’s own set. Earned on the reward track, never sold.

racks.name: Matched to the Table
racks.blurb: Racks cut from the table’s own wood, with a brass line along the lip.

racks.name: Club Walnut
racks.blurb: Oiled walnut with chamfered edges, green baize ledges and brass end caps.

racks.name: Rosewood & Brass
racks.blurb: Polished rosewood strung with twin brass lines, its ledges lined in oxblood leather.

racks.name: Trunk Maker
racks.blurb: Walnut and pale beech, forest-green suede and a row of brass rivets, like a travelling games trunk.

racks.name: Black Lacquer & Gold
racks.blurb: Mirror-black lacquer edged in engraved gold, with cinnabar velvet ledges.

racks.name: Ebony & Mother of Pearl
racks.blurb: Gloss ebony inlaid with mother-of-pearl panels, set in silver on midnight velvet.

racks.name: Zitan & Jade
racks.blurb: Dark zitan wood with carved jade cartouches framed in gold, and jade cabochons on the caps.

racks.name: Imperial Gilt
racks.blurb: Solid gilt engraved with clouds, jade inlays, ruby cabochons and crimson velvet. The emperor’s own.

envs.name: The Private Club
envs.blurb: Walnut panelling, porcelain shelves and a lacquer pendant. Low light, leather and brass.

envs.name: Tokyo Neon
envs.blurb: A tatami room behind shoji screens, neon and rain beyond the glass.

envs.name: Taipei Night Market
envs.blurb: Red lacquer columns, a moon gate and strings of lanterns over the street.

envs.name: Dubai Majlis
envs.blurb: Mashrabiya arches, zellige floor and a pierced brass lantern at desert sunset.

envs.name: Manhattan Loft
envs.blurb: Brick, steel-framed windows and Edison bulbs above a midnight skyline.

envs.name: Shanghai 1930s
envs.blurb: A jazz-age lounge in black lacquer and gold, the Bund lit up across the river.

envs.name: Sky Penthouse
envs.blurb: Daylight, white marble and glass, high over a calm sea.

envs.name: Kyoto Garden
envs.blurb: An open tea pavilion over a bamboo grove and maple garden, in soft afternoon light.

envs.name: Forbidden City
envs.blurb: Vermilion columns, painted beams and gold. The emperor’s own hall.

envs.name: Hong Kong Tea House
envs.blurb: Teak booths, green-tiled walls, birdcages and a slow ceiling fan above a busy street. Or open it free with the World Tour stamp: win a game of hong kong mahjong.

envs.name: Tokyo Jansō
envs.blurb: A Shōwa-era mahjong parlour: square table lamps, rule boards, quiet tables and rain on the window. Or open it free with the World Tour stamp: win a game of japanese riichi.

envs.name: Al Fahidi Majlis
envs.blurb: Coral-stone walls, a palm-frond ceiling, sadu cushions and the scent of cardamom coffee. Or open it free with the World Tour stamp: win a game at a dubai club table.
